notes: Memory between rooms now runs both ways. Characters already carried a group conversation into their private chat; they carry their private chat into the group as well, so something you worked out one to one can be picked straight up in front of everyone without repeating it. Each of them brings only their own conversation with you — nobody arrives knowing what you said to somebody else, since that would be a leak rather than continuity — and they are told it is theirs to raise or keep quiet about, which is roughly how a person would treat it. A character you have never spoken to privately brings nothing, and the whole recollection stays bounded so a long history cannot crowd out the conversation it is attached to.
